value.rationale: A canonical Catalan-sized state space has legal elementary adjacent swaps but a nonisometric induced metric, shown already at order 3. The exact all-order maximum transformation cost and forced twice-crossing bottleneck are structurally motivated; the odd-order unique extremal pair adds a meaningful metric classification, rather than arbitrary finite enumeration.
